```{python}
import json
import _lib as L
meta = L.run_meta()
```

This page shows the files a person needs in order to repeat the run, as they are in the repository:
[`REQUIREMENTS.md`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/REQUIREMENTS.md),
[`requirements.txt`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/requirements.txt),
[`requirements-lock.txt`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/requirements-lock.txt) and
[`config/biologia_sp.yaml`](https://github.com/ibe-datascience/jutro-pilot-slownictwo/blob/main/config/biologia_sp.yaml).

## Requirements

```{python}
L.include_markdown(L.ROOT / "REQUIREMENTS.md", shift=1)
```

## Python dependencies

`requirements.txt`, the direct dependencies with the versions of the published run:

```{python}
L.code_file(L.ROOT / "requirements.txt", "bash")
```

`requirements-lock.txt` holds the complete `pip freeze` of that environment
(`{python} sum(1 for l in (L.ROOT / "requirements-lock.txt").read_text().splitlines() if l and not l.startswith("#"))`
packages).

## Configuration

Subject, school stage, grades, thresholds, models and the seed are parameters. To repeat the process for another
subject, copy the file and change the `cel` section.

```{python}
L.code_file(L.ROOT / "config" / f"{L.NAME}.yaml", "yaml")
```

## Record of this run

### Library versions

Saved by the pipeline in `przebieg.json` at the time of the run.

```{python}
L.table(meta.get("wersje", {}).items(), ["Component", "Version"], "ll")
```

### Steps

```{python}
from datetime import datetime
rows = []
for name, t in meta.get("kroki", {}).items():
    a, b = datetime.fromisoformat(t["start"]), datetime.fromisoformat(t["koniec"])
    rows.append((name, a.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), b.strftime("%H:%M:%S"), f"{(b - a).total_seconds():.0f} s"))
L.table(rows, ["Step (last execution)", "Start", "End", "Duration"], "lllr")
L.md(f"Seed: `{meta.get('ziarno')}`. The record keeps the last execution of each step; a step that was run in an "
     "earlier session and not repeated may be missing from it.")
```

### Raw metrics files {#raw-metrics-files}

Every number on the [Results](results.qmd) page comes from one of these files.

```{python}
for p in sorted((L.OUT / "metryki").glob("*.json")):
    d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    body = json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    L.md(f"::: {{.callout-note collapse=\"true\" title=\"{p.name} · saved {d.get('_zapisano', '')}\"}}\n"
         f"[view on GitHub]({L.REPO}/blob/main/{L.rel(p)})\n\n````json\n{body}\n````\n:::")
```
